description: Tell My Noticeboard about one local community group, service, event or useful leaflet, citing the public page that announces it (source_url). A curator checks it against that page before anything is published. Community-led and voluntary activity, charities and public services only; not businesses. Give no individual’s own phone or email. Needs an API key. Returns a receipt; a retry with the same idempotency_key returns the same receipt.

description.description: One or two plain sentences on what it is.

kind.description: group: a group, club, service or charity; event: a one-off or regular session; resource: a leaflet, guide or website.

link.description: For a resource: where to read it.

source_url.description: The public page that announces it, starting https://

when.description: When a group meets, in words, e.g. "Mondays 2pm to 4pm, term time".

name: suggest_listing
title: Suggest a group, service or event we don’t list
